## Pull request overview

This PR fixes a critical naming inconsistency in the `@object-ui/plugin-charts` package where the bar chart component was registered as `'chart-bar'` but tests expected `'bar-chart'`. The fix ensures consistent naming throughout the codebase, resolving 3 failing tests in the GitHub Actions workflow.

**Changes:**
- Updated component type from `'chart-bar'` to `'bar-chart'` in TypeScript interfaces, component registry, exports, and tests
- Updated all documentation examples to use the corrected `'bar-chart'` naming
- Established consistent naming convention for the bar chart component across the entire codebase

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 5 out of 5 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/plugin-charts/src/types.ts | Updated BarChartSchema interface type literal and JSDoc example from 'chart-bar' to 'bar-chart' |
| packages/plugin-charts/src/index.tsx | Updated ComponentRegistry registration key and chartComponents export object key from 'chart-bar' to 'bar-chart' |
| packages/plugin-charts/src/index.test.ts | Updated all test cases to reference 'bar-chart' instead of 'chart-bar' |
| packages/plugin-charts/README.md | Updated code examples and schema documentation to use 'bar-chart' type |
| docs/plugins/plugin-charts.md | Updated all documentation examples and schema references to use 'bar-chart' type |
</details>
The comment still references 'chart-bar' but should be updated to 'bar-chart' for consistency with the component naming changes throughout this PR.
